description: SSOT for all typography token values. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-typography-font-primary.role: Primary font for body text, headings, UI

TK-typography-font-secondary.value: 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
TK-typography-font-secondary.role: Secondary font for headlines, display text

TK-typography-font-mono.role: Monospace font for code, data, technical content

TK-typography-size-display.role: Display text — hero headings, landing pages

TK-typography-size-body.role: Body text — paragraphs, form labels, lists

TK-typography-size-caption.role: Caption text — image captions, footnotes, legal

TK-typography-weight-light.role: Light weight — display text, large headings

TK-typography-weight-regular.role: Regular weight — body text, UI labels

TK-typography-lineheight-tight.role: Tight line height — headings, display text

TK-typography-lineheight-normal.role: Normal line height — body text, UI

TK-typography-lineheight-relaxed.role: Relaxed line height — long-form reading, articles

TK-typography-letterspacing-tight.role: Tight letter spacing — headings, display text

TK-typography-letterspacing-normal.role: Normal letter spacing — body text, UI

TK-typography-letterspacing-wide.role: Wide letter spacing — labels, captions, uppercase
